limitations: The exact team STM32 part, ABI, compiler/library/startup configuration, flash/RAM budgets and task/deadline/recovery ownership remain unknown; these candidates do not select them.

This compiles one producer unit into relocatables. It neither links all five units nor supplies/reset/startup/HAL/interrupt/controller scheduling/physical signals. Unresolved helpers may dominate linked size, numerical behavior or execution cost.

Clang static assertions and strict flags constrain translation; generated Cortex-M4 code has not been executed. Host bit-parity and sanitizers remain prior host evidence, not target parity or safety certification.

Binary64 arithmetic, ordinary rounding/subnormal retention and source epsilon quirks remain unchanged. Single-precision FPU metadata and an assembly listing cannot establish correct target runtime behavior of double operations.

No target/HIL/emulation, firmware image, CAN/transport, flashing, motor mapping/calibration/traction policy, real hardware actuation, whole-stack/resource-fit/deadline/WCET or independent shutdown authority.
